# 🛡️ ADFSSignInLogs Threat Hunting Workbook

**Purpose:** Hunt across federated ADFS authentication events captured in the `ADFSSignInLogs` table, and **cross-correlate with `SignInLogs`, `SecurityEvent`, `AuditLogs` and `Heartbeat`** to surface attacks that bypass or tamper with the ADFS log stream itself. Every tile honours the same exclusion pills (`ExcludedIPs`, `WatchlistFilter`, `ExcludedCountries`, `Apps`, `Issuers`) so what you hunt is exactly what the companion analytic rules in `Analytic-Rules/azuredeploy.json` see. Three additional pills (`PrivilegedUsers`, `BreakGlassUsers`, `ServiceAccountPattern`) scope the Privileged & Persistence tab to your Tier-0 estate.

---

## 👥 Audience map

| Tab | Primary audience | What it answers |
|---|---|---|
| 📊 **Overview** | Management / IAM leads | Are ADFS sign-ins healthy? Where do they originate? Which apps drive the volume? |
| 🔴 **Brute Force** | SOC analysts | Who is being hammered? Which IPs are attacking? Did any brute-force succeed? |
| 🟠 **Password Spray** | SOC analysts | Which IPs target many accounts? Are we seeing low-and-slow campaigns? |
| 🌍 **Geolocation** | SOC analysts | Where are sign-ins coming from? Impossible travel? First-time-from-country? |
| 🛡️ **Token Issuer** | SOC analysts / Identity engineers | Golden SAML candidates, high SAML volume, MFA outcome breakdown |
| 🔍 **Legacy / ROPC** | Identity engineers | Who still uses legacy auth, ROPC or device-code flows that bypass MFA/CA? |
| 🤖 **Botnet** | SOC analysts | Same UA across many users, IP reuse, heartbeat cadence (C2 signal) |
| 👑 **Privileged & Persistence** | IAM / Tier-0 owners | Break-glass use, privileged sign-in diversity, service accounts doing interactive auth, new / revived relying parties, issuer drift per app, long-lived token reuse (`T1078`, `T1098`, `T1606.002`, `T1550.004`) |
| 🧠 **Behavior & Anomalies** | SOC / UEBA | MFA fatigue → success, time-of-day anomalies vs per-user baseline, distributed (subnet-level) password spray, MFA → single-factor drift, UA entropy per user, near-threshold failure suppression, sign-in → `AuditLogs` privilege-action correlation |
| 👻 **Advanced Threats** | Threat hunters / IR | Ghost Golden SAML (`SignInLogs` federated success with no ADFS record), Hybrid Health log tampering (per-node volume drop + `SecurityEvent 1200` divergence), external IPs claiming intranet status, modern UA hitting legacy WS-Trust endpoints, on-prem AD lockout (`4740`) without ESL `396083` (ESL bypass) |

---

## 📊 Overview

- **Security Metrics Summary** — tile row: Total / Successful / Failed sign-ins, Failure Rate %, Unique Users / IPs / Locations / Issuers.
- **Sign-in Activity Trend** — timechart of Success vs Failure per hour.
- **Top Error Codes** — pie of the top 10 ADFS + Entra error codes mapped to human-readable reasons (e.g. `396083` → ADFS extranet lockout).
- **Sign-ins by Token Issuer** — sign-in count and unique users per `TokenIssuerName` / `TokenIssuerType`.
- **Top Applications / Relying Parties** — bar chart of the 15 most-used `AppDisplayName` values, with failure rate per app.
- **7-Day Baseline Deviation** — daily current-vs-baseline % change, with 🔴 / 🟠 / 🟡 / 🟢 indicators on volume & failure spikes.

## 🔴 Brute Force

- **SOC Alert Tiles (last 24h)** — coloured tiles: Extranet Lockouts · Password Spray IPs · Brute-Force Users · High-Risk Country Sign-ins. Anything > 0 lights up red.
- **Top Accounts by Failed Sign-ins** — 25 most-failed users with IP fan-out, error codes, countries.
- **Extranet Lockout (396083) per User** — sustained lockout campaigns; threshold = `FailureThreshold` pill.
- **Brute Force – Single Account Targeted** — `>2 × FailureThreshold` failures from multiple IPs against one account.
- **Brute Force – Failure → Success Chain** — failed run followed by a successful sign-in within 1 h (compromise indicator).
- **Attacking IPs** — IPs with the highest failure count, including UA / country / target sample.
- **Brute Force Timeline** — failure count per hour by error code.

## 🟠 Password Spray

- **Spray Sources** — IPs targeting more than `FailureThreshold` distinct accounts with credential errors.
- **Spray Victims** — accounts touched by > 3 distinct attacker IPs.
- **Low-and-Slow Spray** — 2–15 attempts/hour per IP, sustained over ≥ 3 hours (evades per-account lockout).

## 🌍 Geolocation

- **Sign-ins World Map** — interactive map enriched via `geo_info_from_ip_address()`, coloured by failure rate, sized by volume.
- **Sign-ins by Country** — top 20 countries with sign-ins / failures / unique users.
- **High-Risk Country Sign-Ins** — tuned country watchlist (`KP, IR, RU, BY, CU, SY, VE, MM` by default — edit in tile).
- **Impossible Travel** — same user, 3+ countries within a 1-hour window.
- **First-Time Country per User** — leftanti join against a `BaselineDays` / `BaselineOffsetDays` baseline.

## 🛡️ Token Issuer & Golden SAML

- **MFA Outcome Breakdown** — pie of MFA Succeeded / MFA Failed / Single-Factor Succeeded / Single-Factor Failed across `AuthenticationRequirement`.
- **MFA Required but Failed/Interrupted** — top 25 users where MFA was required but the sign-in failed (possible MFA fatigue / blocked challenge).
- **Unexpected Token Issuers** — `TokenIssuerName` not in your sanctioned list (Golden SAML candidate — edit `ExpectedIssuers` in tile).
- **High SAML Token Volume** — > 50 tokens/hour per user+IP (automated token replay).
- **Single-Factor Authentication on ADFS** — successful federated sign-ins that bypassed MFA.

## 🔍 Legacy / ROPC

- **Legacy Auth via UserAgent** — `ActiveSync`, `BAV2ROPC`, `IMAP`, `POP`, old Office UAs.
- **ROPC or Device Code Flow** — flagged via `AuthenticationProcessingDetails` (high-risk OAuth flows).

## 🤖 Botnet

- **Same UserAgent Across Many Accounts** — > 50 distinct users sharing one UA.
- **IP Reuse Across Many Accounts** — > 20 distinct users from one IP.
- **Heartbeat / C2 Cadence** — low standard-deviation gap between successful sign-ins per user+IP (`serialize` + `prev()`).

## � Privileged & Persistence

- **Break-Glass Account Activity** — any sign-in from a UPN in the `BreakGlassUsers` pill (any use is alert-worthy).
- **Privileged Account Sign-Ins** — volume, country / IP / app diversity, MFA-less successes per privileged UPN matched by `PrivilegedUsers` substrings.
- **Service Accounts Doing Interactive Auth** — `ServiceAccountPattern`-matched UPNs sending browser-class UAs (Mozilla/Chrome/Edg/Safari/Firefox).
- **New Relying Parties / Apps** — `AppDisplayName` first-seen in the current `TimeRange` and not present in the `BaselineDays`+`BaselineOffsetDays` baseline (leftanti).
- **Recently-Inactive Apps Suddenly Active** — apps whose recent volume is ≥ 5× their baseline and whose baseline trailed off > 7 days ago.
- **Token-Issuer Drift per Application** — `(AppDisplayName, TokenIssuerName)` pairs not seen in baseline (Golden SAML / federation pivot).
- **Long-Lived Token Reuse** — same `UniqueTokenIdentifier` from ≥ 3 IPs or with > 12 h lifespan.

## 🧠 Behavior & Anomalies

- **MFA Fatigue → Success** — ≥ 5 MFA prompts/failures (`50074, 50076, 500121, 50158`) followed by an MFA success within 6 h.
- **Time-of-Day Anomaly** — successful sign-ins outside the user's `BaselineDays` normal-hour set.
- **Distributed Password Spray** — `/24` subnets where ≥ 5 IPs each target 2–5 accounts (inverse of single-IP spray).
- **Authentication Method Drift** — users who were > 70 % MFA in baseline but are now > 50 % single-factor success.
- **UA Entropy per User** — users with ≥ 4 distinct UserAgents and high `dcount(UA) / signins` ratio.
- **Failure Suppression / Near-Threshold** — IPs sustaining failure counts between 60–100 % of `FailureThreshold` across ≥ 3 hours.
- **Sign-In → Privileged-Action Correlation** — `AuditLogs` role / app / federation changes within 1 h of a suspicious sign-in (`union isfuzzy=true`).

## � Behavior & Anomalies

- **Ghost Golden SAML** — `SignInLogs` federated successes whose UPN has no `ADFSSignInLogs` event within ± 5 minutes (forged SAML bypasses on-prem entirely).
- **Log-Tampering: Volume Drop per ADFS Node** — hourly `Computer`-grouped volume vs 7-day baseline; flags SILENT (< 30 %), LOW (< 70 %), SPIKE (> 3×).
- **SecurityEvent vs ADFSSignInLogs Divergence** — Windows `EventID 1200` (token issued) per Computer vs ADFS events per hour; flags drift > 20 events & > 25 % missing (Hybrid Health Agent tamper / DPAPI key abuse).
- **External IPs Claiming Intranet Status** — `NetworkLocationDetails.networkType == intranet` but `IPAddress` is non-RFC1918 / hyperscaler-CIDR / foreign country (X-Forwarded-For spoof).
- **Modern UA → Legacy WS-Trust Endpoint** — Chrome/Edge/Firefox UAs hitting `/adfs/services/trust/2005/usernamemixed` or `wstrust` protocol (UA spoof + protocol downgrade).
- **Lockout Desync (ESL bypass)** — `SecurityEvent 4740` (on-prem AD lockout) with zero `396083` ADFS ESL hits in the prior 7 days for that user.

- **Failure Reasons Breakdown** — error code → reason table covering ADFS-specific codes (`396083, 30030, 30008`) and Entra codes (`50053, 50057, 50055, 50126, 50034, 50074, 50076, 50079, 53003, 500121, 530032`). Falls back to `ResultDescription`.
- **Recent Account Lockouts** — latest 30 events with user / IP / location / app / UA / issuer for helpdesk triage.
- **Average ADFS Sign-in Duration** — Avg / P50 / P95 / P99 of `DurationMs` (or `ProcessingTimeInMs`) per hour via `column_ifexists()` so it degrades gracefully on tenants without that field.
- **Service Availability** — hours with zero successful sign-ins or no traffic (outage detector).
- **Raw Event Drill-Down** — filterable / sortable grid of the latest 500 events for root-cause analysis.

---

## 🧩 Exclusion model (applies to every tile)

Each tile begins with a parameter-driven prelude that **shadows `ADFSSignInLogs` with a filtered version**, so downstream KQL stays clean. Filters AND-combine across pills, OR-combine within a multi-select.

Order applied: **ExcludedIPs → NetworkAllowlist → Countries → Apps → Issuers**.

| Pill | Type | Behaviour |
|---|---|---|
| `ExcludedIPs` | Free text | Comma-separated single IPv4 / CIDR / `a.b.c.d-e.f.g.h` range. Empty = no IP filter. |
| `WatchlistFilter` | Off / On | When **On**, the prelude appends `| invoke ExcludeAllowlistedIPs()` (the production function used by the analytic rules). When **Off**, the prelude reduces to `| where true` - zero cost. |
| `ExcludedCountries` | Multi-select | Drops rows by `Location`. Populated from data (last 30 d). |
| `Apps` | Multi-select | Drops rows by `AppDisplayName`. Populated from data (last 30 d). |
| `Issuers` | Multi-select | Drops rows by `TokenIssuerName`. Populated from data — use sparingly, hides Golden SAML signal. |
| `PrivilegedUsers` | Free text | Comma-separated substrings (`has_any`) matched against UPN — scopes the Privileged tab. Default: `admin,sync_,svc-,service`. |
| `BreakGlassUsers` | Free text | Comma-separated **exact** UPNs of emergency accounts. Any sign-in is flagged. Default: empty. |
| `ServiceAccountPattern` | Free text | Comma-separated substrings identifying service / non-interactive accounts. Default: `svc-,sa-,service_,_svc`. |

> 💡 Set **Use NetworkAllowlist = true** to align this workbook 1:1 with the analytic rules deployed by `Analytic-Rules/azuredeploy.json` (which call the same watchlist via `ExcludeAllowlistedIPs()`).

---

## 🔌 Required tables & connectors

| Table | Used by |
|---|---|
| `ADFSSignInLogs` | every tile (Azure AD connector — ADFS sign-in stream) |
| `SignInLogs` | 👻 Advanced Threats → Ghost Golden SAML (`union isfuzzy=true`) |
| `SecurityEvent` (EventID `1200`, `4740`) | 👻 Advanced Threats → log-tampering divergence + lockout desync (`union isfuzzy=true`) |
| `AuditLogs` | 🧠 Behavior → sign-in → privileged-action correlation (`union isfuzzy=true`) |
| `Watchlist: NetworkAllowlist` + function `ExcludeAllowlistedIPs()` | optional - only when `WatchlistFilter = On` (deployed by `Analytic-Rules/azuredeploy.json`) |

## ⚙️ Tuning checklist after import

1. **Token Issuer → Unexpected Token Issuers** — replace `YOUR_ADFS_FEDERATION_SERVICE_NAME` with your sanctioned ADFS hostnames.
2. **Geolocation → High-Risk Country Sign-Ins** — adjust the `HighRisk` dynamic list to match your org policy.
3. **Brute Force → SOC Alert Tiles** — the `last 24h` window is hard-coded; widen if needed.
4. **Failure Threshold pill** — defaults to `10`; raise for high-volume tenants, lower for tightly-scoped tenants.
5. **Baseline Period / Offset** — `30 / 1` by default; adjust for noisy environments.
6. **Privileged / Break-Glass / Service-Account pills** — populate before using the 👑 Privileged tab. Break-glass should be **exact UPNs**; the other two are **substring** patterns.
7. **Advanced Threats** — the cross-log tiles use `union isfuzzy=true` so missing `SignInLogs` / `SecurityEvent` / `AuditLogs` tables degrade gracefully. Onboard those tables to LAW to light up Ghost Golden SAML, log-tampering and ESL-bypass detections.

---

## 🧩 Baseline & Exclusions filters

---

Use the pills above to tune every tile in this workbook without editing any KQL. Exclusions can be **free-text** *(Excluded IPs)*, **dropdown-driven** *(Countries, Apps, Issuers)* or **watchlist-driven** *(NetworkAllowlist)*.

| Filter | What it does | Default |
|---|---|---|
| **Time Range** | Window applied to all queries via `{TimeRange}`. | Last 7 days |
| **Failure Threshold** | Minimum failed-sign-in count for brute-force / spray heuristics. | `10` |
| **Baseline Period (Days)** | Lookback for first-seen / new-country logic. | `30` |
| **Baseline Offset (Days)** | Days to skip between baseline window and now. | `1` |
| **Excluded IPs / CIDR / Ranges** | Trusted IPs removed from every tile via `ipv4_is_in_any_range()`. Comma-separated. Single IPv4, CIDR (`10.0.0.0/8`) or range (`10.0.0.1-10.0.0.255`). Empty = no IP filter. | *(empty)* |
| **Use NetworkAllowlist Watchlist** | When `true`, also drop IPs found in the Sentinel `NetworkAllowlist` watchlist (`IPOrRange` column). Mirrors the `ExcludeAllowlistedIPs()` function deployed by `Analytic-Rules/azuredeploy.json`. Requires the watchlist to exist. | `false` |
| **Countries (Exclude)** | Drop rows whose `Location` matches selection. Populated from data over last 30d. | *(empty)* |
| **Apps (Exclude)** | Drop rows by `AppDisplayName`. Populated from data over last 30d. Useful to silence noisy native clients. | *(empty)* |
| **Token Issuers (Exclude)** | Drop rows by `TokenIssuerName`. Populated from data over last 30d. Use sparingly - filtering issuers hides Golden SAML signals. | *(empty)* |

> **How exclusions are applied** - every query is wrapped with a parameter-driven prelude that *shadows* `ADFSSignInLogs` with a filtered version, so downstream KQL is unchanged. Order: ExcludedIPs > NetworkAllowlist > Countries > Apps > Issuers. All exclusions AND-combine across pills, OR-combine within a multi-select.

> **About the NetworkAllowlist watchlist** - deployed by `Analytic-Rules/azuredeploy.json` (parameter `watchlistAlias`, default `NetworkAllowlist`). Schema: `IPOrRange,Name,Description`. The dropdown reads the watchlist live via `_GetWatchlist('NetworkAllowlist')` so a daily sync runbook (`Watchlists/Sync-NamedLocationsToWatchlist.ps1`) can refresh it from Entra Named Locations without touching the workbook.

### 🍳 Common exclusion recipes

| Goal | Filter values |
|---|---|
| **Hide corporate egress** (parity with analytic rules) | *Use NetworkAllowlist* = `true` |
| **Hide one VPN range temporarily** | *Excluded IPs* = `10.20.30.0/24` |
| **Hunt only on third-country activity** | *Countries (Exclude)* = `United States, United Kingdom, Spain, ...` (your trusted set) |
| **Silence sync clients** | *Apps (Exclude)* = `OneDrive SyncEngine`, `Microsoft Teams` |
| **Focus on Golden SAML candidates** | leave *Token Issuers* empty (it is an exclusion filter) |

---
